resources.string: Import into Android
Selected calendars are copied to Android in read-only mode. Nothing is uploaded to Proton.
Event contents are stored in Android Calendar and can be read by other apps with calendar access.
Android read and write calendar permissions are needed to create and update these local copies, even though Proton stays read-only.
